diagnostic: AssertionError in the optional draft-mover AST comparison after copying the four approved test functions.
confirmed_cause: The comparison read its new UTF-8 target with Path.read_text() without an encoding. The Windows default was cp1252. A bounded comparison identified only the Unicode parameter-matrix function as different under that incorrect decoder.
qualification: This failed draft check is retained and is not accepted AST-equivalence evidence. The copied Unicode cases remain in UTF-8 source and are exercised by the focused behavioral suite. Subsequent evidence readers specify UTF-8 explicitly.
